description:
Ask for the beta access code a new account needs (create_account's access_code).
    email is where the code is sent; note is optional (who you are, up to 500
    characters). The owner approves the request and the code is emailed at once; it works
    once, in any agent or on the web. Returns status pending (waiting for approval) or
    emailed (sent now). No key needed. Limited to 5 per address per hour. Free.
name: request_access
